investigations.name: mosaic-foundations
investigations.title: mosaic-foundations
investigations.description: MOSAIC Foundations — a capabilities showcase. One runnable study per model type, each grounded in MOSAIC biology, demonstrating the variety the framework supports: dynamic FBA (metabolism), community ODE gLV (vaginal BV, Stein 2013, inline Antimony via viva-tellurium), kinetic/PK-PD ODE (estrogen enterohepatic recycling, inline Antimony), spatial/ABM (viva-munk particle colony, viva-cpm gut crypt, vivarium-tyssue epithelial sheet), and process-bigraph composition coupling two of them. Serves as the clear foundation the three science Aims build on.

investigations.name: paper-derived-models
investigations.title: Paper-derived mechanistic models
investigations.description: Two literature-derived mechanistic model studies grouped as one campaign: a BV biogenic-amine cross-feeding ODE and a recreation of the Kim 2021 one-carbon / menstrual-cycle model.
investigations.question:
Can mechanistic models recreated from the women's-health / bacterial-vaginosis
literature reproduce their source papers' quantitative claims inside the MOSAIC
process-bigraph composition framework?
investigations.hypothesis:
Quantitative mechanisms reported in the reading list — a biogenic-amine
cross-feeding loop (Borgogna 2021, Puebla-Barragan 2021) and estradiol control
of one-carbon metabolism (Kim, Nijhout & Reed 2021) — can each be wrapped as a
runnable composite and reproduce the paper's headline behaviour (bistable
healthy/BV states; homocysteine varying inversely with estradiol over the cycle).
